text:
evan: Quick note: spotted several broken anchors in the docs after the Docusaurus + MkDocs consolidation. Links with parens, plus signs, and mixed case are the main culprits (e.g., `/reference/clients#c%2B%2B-usage`, `/guides/migrate#OAuth-flow`, `/examples/sdk#GetUser`).

harper: Repro'd locally. The rendered heading ids are normalized to ascii lower-case with punctuation removed (so `C++ Usage` -> `c-plus-plus-usage`, `OAuth flow` -> `oauth-flow`). Our legacy links still use encoded chars or original casing.

sam: Options: 1) add explicit header ids for specific high-traffic pages, 2) run a repo-wide regex to rewrite old links, or 3) a tiny client-side normalizer to map incoming hashes to generated slugs. 1+2 are content-heavy, 3 is quick stopgap.

ev an: (typo) I'll do 1 for top pages and open an issue for 2. For the interim, can someone prototype the client-side mapper?

sam: PR opened with prototype script and three header fixes: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4401. Script decodes location.hash, applies the same slugify rules we expect (map + -> - or 'plus' per our policy), lowercases, strips punctuation, then tries to replace the hash so the browser jumps. Example snippet in the PR:```js
const normalize = h => decodeURIComponent(h.replace(/^#/, ''))
  .replace(/\+/g, 'plus')
  .replace(/[^a-z0-9\-]/gi, '-')
  .replace(/-+/g, '-')
  .toLowerCase();
if (!document.getElementById(normalize(location.hash))) {
  const alt = normalize(location.hash);
  if (document.getElementById(alt)) location.replace('#'+alt);
}
```

harper: Client-side helps but we should also publish a migration note listing the characters that changed mapping (+: plus OR -, spaces->-, parentheses removed) and recommend explicit header ids like `### C++ usage {#c-plus-plus-usage}` for stable links.

evan: I've added a short section to `docs/migration/slugs.md` and patched five hotspots. Build-bot, can you run linkcheck on the PR preview?

build-bot: Preview build started for PR 4401  linkcheck running.

build-bot: Linkcheck result: 2 warnings (external redirects), 0 failures. Client-side mapper not required for these pages but remains in theme for safety.

harper: Cool. Filed issue #238 to track a follow-up script that scans the repo for `#` links containing `%` or `+` or uppercase letters and suggests fixes. I'll take that if nobody objects.

sam: No objections. One small nit in the PR: escape inline `<Client>` example in the SDK snippet so it doesn't generate an unintended heading. Left a comment.

evan: Fixed and merged. Closing this thread  reopen if anyone finds more encoded anchors.
